features: [BEST DIY CAMERA GIFT FOR KIDS] This kids camera is both a digital camera and an instant print camera for kids which allows kids to take color images, record 1080p HD videos and print black&white photos. Moreover, this instant print camera also comes with 5 colored pens for DIY to stimulate children’s imagination and creativity. Fun Birthday/Christmas/Daily gift for kids age 3-14.

[INKLESS INSTANT PRINT CAMERA FOR KIDS] This kids instant camera adopts advanced inkless technology to print without toner. Kids can instantly freeze and print images on 2.16*3.15inch (5.5*8cm) skin-friendly paper in seconds with a simple press. (3 Rolls Print Paper for up to 150 photos are included in the package)

[UP TO 48MP DUAL LENS & 2.5K HD VIDEO] This HiMont children's camera is equipped with 48MP front and rear dual lenses, which can take photos and videos anytime and anywhere even when there is no printing paper. Under the photo and video functions, high-definition color images and 1080P videos will be automatically saved in the 32G memory card. The video resolution can be adjusted in the settings, up to 2.5K. It also has 10X digital zoom function. (32G memory card is included in the package)

[MULTIFUNCTIONAL & EASY TO OPERATE] This kids camera has 6 functions, such as color photography, high-definition video, black & white printing, music, playback and games, which allows your kids to operate easily and have fun. Moreover, In order to help your child better record every meaningful moment of their childhood, the camera also has built-in 6 kinds of color filters, 20 kinds of cartoon photo frames & characters, etc., and supports continuous shooting, timer shooting and other functions.

[PRIVACY SAFE & USB TRANSFER] To better protect the privacy of you and your children, this instant camera for children only supports file transfer via USB cable. In order to better preserve the precious moments you have taken, it is recommended to regularly back up the files in the camera to a computer for storage.
